message: No detected input validation: The code passes request JSON data directly to calculation classes and PDF templates without any explicit schema, type, or range validation before use; only exception catching (TypeError) is used as a fallback.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code does not fetch data from any remote source (URL, S3, HuggingFace, etc.) in the visible pipeline, so no integrity verification or source authentication is implemented.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious inputs on any incoming data; user-supplied JSON is passed directly to calculation classes without sanitization beyond type-error catching.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models; it is a Flask web application performing statistical calculations, so no model integrity verification is applicable or implemented.

No detected label distribution validation: The code is a Flask web application with no ML training pipeline; there is no label distribution validation or class balance checking anywhere in the codebase.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No training loop exists in this code; it is a Flask web app with no backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are present; the code contains no ML training at all.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress tests are present in the code; it is a Flask web application performing statistical genetic calculations.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics; the code is a web application with no ML evaluation pipeline components.
No detected input sanitization: Incoming JSON is consumed directly via request.get_json() and passed to calculation classes without any schema validation, type checks, or sanitization before use.

No detected output bounds checks: Results from calculation classes (HardyWeinbergCalculation, ChiSquareCalculation, etc.) are returned directly via jsonify without any bounds, NaN, or sanity checks on the output values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline does not use an LLM; it performs statistical/genetic calculations, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
